text:
Which statement describes convection in a liquid?
A
The particles expand and become less dense.
B
The hot liquid becomes less dense and rises.
C
The hot liquid becomes more dense and rises.
D
The particles get further apart and fall.

options.label: A
options.text: The particles expand and become less dense.

options.label: B
options.text: The hot liquid becomes less dense and rises.

options.label: C
options.text: The hot liquid becomes more dense and rises.

options.label: D
options.text: The particles get further apart and fall.

subject: Physics
